newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil's heating oil sales in Norway rise 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Statoil's heating oil sales in Norway rise 30 pct.

text.p: Domestic sales of heating oil in Norway have risen 30 percent so far this year compared with the same period a year ago, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday.
Statoil said it had sold 330 million litres of heating oil in the first 10 months of the year, against 255 million litres in the 1995 period.
"This primarily reflects the rise in Norwegian electricity prices," the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Heating oil prices to domestic consumers have risen from 2.64 crowns per litre excluding tax last summer to 3.13 crowns in third quarter 1996. The average price in 1995 was 2.55 crowns per litre.
